expected_assertion: Use only the latest applicable evidence and the delivered user facts. Preserve the route and supported passenger-car profile. Call only the current-price tool for this request, once per delivered price request. Lead with the estimate, disclose observed versus modeled versus published-schedule provenance, and retain material availability qualifications. Report supplied movement and comparisons accurately without predicting future tolls. No invented prices, timestamps, route substitutions, or internal IDs. Equivalent wording and formatting are acceptable. Use the annual tool independently of current pricing, only after all required facts and any required choice or confirmation have been delivered. Retain the two legs, times, weekdays, annual days, and gross income. For success, explain the annual income remaining after assumed tax and the annualized daily-P50 commute, daily P25/P50/P90 combined-cost scenarios, the P50 daily and annual toll, average-monthly and annual combined costs, remaining income, and the additional gross salary needed to offset the combined cost. Separate P25/P90 toll amounts are optional unless explicitly requested by the delivered user. Keep financial amounts and labels tied to their matching result fields. Disclose one-third assumed tax, the fixed $0.685 vehicle-cost assumption per straight-line tolled mile, exclusion of untolled travel, sample coverage, and observed versus modeled versus published-fixed-rate sources. Annualized daily scenarios are not annual percentiles, a forecast, or a guaranteed budget. Equivalent wording and formatting are acceptable. Switch intent only after the delivered annual request; collect its missing income before the annual tool call.
